title: LiveDiff configuration
description: Per-user LiveDiff settings. Omitted properties use LiveDiff defaults.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor completion and validation.

opener.description: Executable and literal arguments used to open a LiveDiff URL. This is argv, not a shell command.

port.description: Preferred loopback port. LiveDiff uses the next available port when this one is occupied.

pollIntervalMs.description: Milliseconds between live worktree checks while a browser is attached.

orphanArchiveAfterDays.description: Archive an open comment after its file has been absent from the diff for this many days.

resolvedArchiveAfterDays.description: Archive a resolved comment after this many untouched days.

purgeAfterDays.description: Permanently delete an archived comment after this many days.

archiveWarningBytes.description: Archive size in bytes at which livediff doctor recommends pruning.

defaultRenderer.description: Default diff renderer. A ?renderer= URL parameter still overrides this per tab.
